feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 August 2026 8:50am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 08 August 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Belgium, drifting eastwards, allowing weak weather fronts to affect the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Mainly South or Southwest 4 or 5 today, but locally Variable 2 or 3 at times in Liverpool and Morecambe Bay. Becoming West or Southwest 3 or 4 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in central and western waters until later.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle slowly spreading from the west tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 3 or 4, veering Northwest tomorrow evening or early tomorrow night, mainly 3 or 4, but 5 for a time in the east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain and drizzle, then becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or in precipitation at first.
